comment: Share cards (OpenGraph/Twitter). headline mirrors the page's own H1 and label its eyebrow — kept here as plain data so the renderer needs no TypeScript. Shorten freely: this is card copy, not the meta title. photo is a path under apps/web; the /news artwork is generated by news-art.mjs and lives in scripts/og/art/, a build input that is never served. A "|" in a headline forces a line break, for Thai phrases with no space to break at.
